archetypes.name: dyn-step2b5-logging
archetypes.rationale: Step 2b.5 now self-logs failure evidence while preserving launcher stdout and rc contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 2b.5 self-logging flow in python/design_lifecycle.py. Verify stdout remains parseable by the orchestrator, stderr is included only in the validation log, and nonzero return codes are preserved. Check that execution-issues append failures cannot mask the original plan-size result. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
